thread:
sam: heads up — sampleapp embed helper is causing rerank to 400. repro in node + python.

sam: minimal error in prod logs:
```json
{"error":"invalid_vector_length","expected_dim":768,"got":770}
```

sam: suspect padding logic in batcher that adds 2 zeros on odd-count batches. happened after latest batch helper bump.

mira: ugh. which SDK version? node or python?

sam: node 1.8.3, python 1.8.3 as well. parity seemed OK but the sampleapp was using the JS helper.

kevin: can you paste the request body you sent to /v1/rerank? quick check: are you sending nested arrays or base64?

sam: sending floats array. snippet:
```json
{"query":"q","candidates":[{"id":"1","vec":[0.12,0.34,...]}, {"id":"2","vec":[...]}],"params":{"batch_id":"b-7"}}
```

sam: helper injects padding like this: `if (len % 2 != 0) vec.push(0,0)` — looks wrong. should be pad to model_dim (768), not pairwise.

mira: oh that would explain 770. was there a refactor for vector alignment for GPU kernels?

kevin: yes earlier runtime change required 16-alignment for some quantized paths but that should be inside runtime, not client. client must send exact dim.

sam: reproduce steps posted in sampleapp repo: https://github.com/redwood/sampleapp/tree/embed-batcher. easy to run: `npm run emu -- --count 3`

devex-bot: CI failed for branch embed-batcher — 3 failing e2e tests (embed-reorder, rerank-format). See https://ci.redwood.ai/2345

jen: I can take a quick patch on the helper. Two things: 1) stop auto-padding except to a config param; 2) add strict validation that vector length === model_dim before sending.

mira: also add an SDK parity test: call the same sample inputs from python and node and assert identical request JSON. we keep seeing tiny differences.

kevin: and add an opt-in alignment flag for on-prem clients that truly need it, documented. default off.

sam: one more wrinkle: auth/retry loop. when node gets 401 on long-running retries it reauths then re-sends but the helper mutates the original batch in-place, so the retried request ends up with padding applied twice. hence 770 -> 772 on second attempt.

jen: nasty. so two fixes: idempotent retry should clone request payload, and validation before send should short-circuit.

mira: can we add a test that simulates an auth failure mid-send? e.g., mock 401 then 200 on retry and assert vector dim unchanged.

jen: will open PR. patch plan in PR body, link in thread when ready.

sam: thanks. rough patch locally passes unit tests. leaving a note in sampleapp README about model_dim config and how to enable alignment.

kevin: filing an infra ticket to make runtime more forgiving with a clear error message if dims mismatch — right now it returns generic 400.

devex-bot: created issue INF-789: Improve rerank error clarity for vector dim mismatch.

mira: great. low-risk fix for SDKs + a parity test should prevent regressions. @jen ping me on PR review. :thumbsup:

sam: thanks all — marking this thread resolved for now, will repost if anything else pops up.
